name: B.Tech / B.E. (PCM route)
eligibility: Class 12 with PCM for this sample route; marks and accepted subject combinations vary by institution.
description: Turn scientific ideas into practical solutions. Explore how engineering disciplines use mathematics, technology and hands-on projects to solve real problems.

name: MBBS
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology and English; practicals, qualifying marks, age and current NEET rules apply.
description: Explore the science and practice of medicine, from understanding the human body to clinical learning and supervised patient care.

name: BDS
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology and English; qualifying marks, age and current admission rules apply.
description: Explore oral health, dental sciences and clinical care through a combination of scientific study and practical training.

name: B.Sc. Physics
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics; additional subjects and marks depend on the university.
description: Investigate matter, energy and the principles behind everyday phenomena. Build quantitative reasoning through theory, experiments and laboratory work.

name: B.Des. (general design route)
eligibility: Class 12 in any stream for many general design programmes; institution and specialisation rules vary.
description: Combine creative thinking with practical problem-solving. Explore how research, visual communication and prototyping shape products and experiences.

name: BBA (general route)
eligibility: Class 12 in any stream for many programmes; some institutions require Mathematics or other conditions.
description: Understand how organisations operate. Explore management, marketing, finance and teamwork through business concepts and applied projects.

name: B.A. LL.B. (integrated)
eligibility: Class 12 in any stream; minimum marks and admission rules vary by institution.
description: Connect humanities with legal study. Explore legal reasoning, institutions, research and the role of law in society.

name: NDA — Air Force / Naval route
duration: 3 years at NDA plus service-specific training
eligibility: Class 12 with PCM; current age, nationality, marital status, medical fitness, SSB and other UPSC conditions apply.
description: Explore an officer-training route that combines academic study, leadership development and military training for the Air Force or Navy.

name: B.Com. (general route)
eligibility: Many institutions accept Class 12 from any stream; some require Commerce, Mathematics or specified subjects.
description: Build a foundation in accounting, commerce and finance. Explore how businesses track performance, manage resources and make decisions.

name: B.A. (general)
eligibility: Class 12 in any stream for many general BA programmes; subject-specific conditions can apply.
description: Explore people, ideas and society through humanities and social sciences. Subject choices shape the emphasis of your degree.
